nodes.label: POST /email/resend-failed - Resend Failed Emails
nodes.rationale: Failures are persisted in a FailedEmail table and retried with a hard cap of 5 retries, and the endpoint is designed to be driven by a cron job rather than by an operator, so transient SMTP outages self-heal without unbounded retry storms.

edges.source_location: both are cron-driven email delivery guarantees; the retry sweep covers reminders that failed to send
the FailedEmail retry sweep replays RFQ sends that did not reach the vendor
